text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I ask Super Creek to write her name on a

document that needs to be signed...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
...Sorry, but could you turn the other
way for a
bit?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
It's just that, um... my skin's flaring up
right now.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I've been asked to do a lot of washing
and
cleaning lately...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
And I guess I've been too busy for
proper skin
care.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I-I asked you not to look! Bad Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I try to check but get scolded instead.
She pushes
my face away, so I stare out
the window for a
while...
